profile.headline: Software Engineer at Affirma
profile.summary:
B.S. in Computer Science at Arizona State University. 
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of proactive learning. 
Extensive skills in Python, Swift, Kotlin, and Agile methodology. 
I love solving complex problems efficiently, rock climbing, eating delicious food, and playing music-- let's connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Software Engineer for Meta - React, Hack (PHP), GraphQL
▪ Android Kotlin app - Architecture design and implementation of a barcode & RFID scanner app, interfaced with REST API
▪ Cross-platform SDK Development - Android (Kotlin) & iOS (Swift)
▪ Developed a Telematics SDK that increased driver safety and personalized car insurance through advanced driver behavior analysis.
▪ The SDK enabled real-time collection, processing, and analysis of extensive driving data through device sensors.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · React.js · Swift (Programming Language) · Hack (PHP) · GraphQL · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
▪ C++ development for Flight Management Systems.
▪ iOS development for Connected Avionics SDK.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Swift (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Worked in an Agile environment to develop real-time embedded system software for a network switch.
▪ Wrote formal DO-178B Level A high-level and low-level requirements.
▪ Developed Python scripts for automated testing of software components.
▪ Communicated critical dependencies between software and hardware components to ensure team cohesion.
▪ Reverse engineered code and implemented software design architecture.
▪ Integrated, debugged, and tested in lab environment with team using an oscilloscope.

positions.title: Math Instructor
positions.description:
▪ Prepared and tutored students in math, ranging from 1st to 12th grade (up to Calculus).
▪ Work in a team setting to facilitate new learning material (lectures, tests, and workout books) to the students as they progress through their prescribed curriculum. 
▪ Working with multiple students at a time (up to 25 per 4-hour session with 4-5 at a time).

projects.description: Fine-grained aircraft image classifier using convolutional neural network.

projects.title: Vendor Agnostic Cloud Solution (General Dynamics Mission Systems)
projects.description:
▪ Planned and developed the prototype cloud infrastructure to reduce total life cycle cost of information systems.
▪ Worked in a team to produce a vendor-agnostic cloud solution with Azure, AWS and Docker.
▪ Developed a cloud-migratable, persistent backend queried by a web app using PostgreSQL and Express.js.
▪ Increased productivity with Scrum framework, leading the database team to produce consistent deliverables.
